---
title: "Variation Graph Construction"
description: "Build individualized genome and transcriptome variation graphs from Exacto variant calls."
---

This pipeline produces individualized genome and transcriptome variation graphs that encode an
individual's variants alongside the reference sequence. These graphs are useful for downstream
variant-aware analyses that benefit from a graph reference instead of a linear one.

## Workflow

```{mermaid}
%%{init: {'securityLevel': 'loose'}}%%
flowchart LR
    DNAV[/"<span style='white-space:nowrap;color:#414a4c'>DNA variants TSV</span>"/] --> BGV(build‑genome‑var‑graph)
    REFG[("<span style='white-space:nowrap;color:#414a4c'>Reference genome FASTA</span>")] --> BGV
    BGV --> GG[/"<span style='white-space:nowrap;color:#414a4c'>Genome variation graph FASTA</span>"/]

    TXS[/"<span style='white-space:nowrap;color:#414a4c'>Transcript model alignments TSV</span>"/] --> BTV(build‑transcriptome‑var‑graph)
    REFG --> BTV
    BTV --> TG[/"<span style='white-space:nowrap;color:#414a4c'>Transcriptome variation graph FASTA</span>"/]

    click BGV href "../cli/build-genome-var-graph.html" "View build-genome-var-graph docs" _self
    click BTV href "../cli/build-transcriptome-var-graph.html" "View build-transcriptome-var-graph docs" _self

    classDef linked text-decoration:underline;
    class BGV,BTV linked
```

The DNA variants TSV is the output of [`call-germline-dna-vars`](../cli/call-germline-dna-vars.qmd)
or [`call-somatic-dna-vars`](../cli/call-somatic-dna-vars.qmd). The transcript model alignments TSV
is the `*_exacto_assembled_transcript_model_alignments.tsv` that
[`call-rna-transcript-vars`](../cli/call-rna-transcript-vars.qmd) writes (see
[Variant-aware Transcriptome Assembly](variant-aware-transcriptome-assembly.qmd)).

## Genome variation graph

Add germline and/or somatic DNA variants to the reference genome. `--only-variant-sequences yes`
writes only the variant sequences, without the reference contigs:

```bash
exacto build-genome-var-graph \
    --variants-tsv-file tumor_somatic_dna_variants.tsv \
    --fasta-file reference_genome.fasta \
    --output-fasta-file tumor_genome_var_graph.fasta \
    --sequence-prefix tumor
```

## Transcriptome variation graph

Build one sequence per assembled transcript from its structure against the reference genome. Each
record is named by its `assembled_transcript_name`:

```bash
exacto build-transcriptome-var-graph \
    --transcript-structures-tsv-file rna_variants/tumor_exacto_assembled_transcript_model_alignments.tsv \
    --fasta-file reference_genome.fasta \
    --output-fasta-file tumor_transcriptome_var_graph.fasta
```
